messages.subject: suggested number of chains
parts:
Dear Stan Users,
Is there a suggested number of chains according to, for example, the number of dimensions?

Thanks!

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] suggested number of chains
parts:
Nope — in the ideal case the performance of the Markov chain
doesn’t depend on dimension.  In reality some nasty pathologies
can be made worse in higher dimensions, but there’s no general
scaling.  So we typically recommend as many as you can, as more
chains means a higher probability of finding pathological parts of
parameter space.  The default is 4 just because most computers
these days have at least 4 cores, but more is always better!

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] suggested number of chains
parts:
You need to schedule your jobs on your cluster. Each
job should have the same seed and different chain ID.
Then you can collect up the results and put them back
together in R or on the command line.

- Bob
